Source/code review was targeted, not exhaustive review of every acquired file or bundled dependency.

The sandbox denies network and user-home reads except explicit trusted Python/Node runtime paths; writes are restricted to synthetic fixtures. It is not a VM or a complete Mach-service/syscall monitor.
API acquisition and hosted MCP probes use the trusted verifier outside candidate sandbox; hosted backend code is not observable.
Package integrity hashes and reachable Git commits do not establish signed provenance or a complete publisher/build chain.
